meanings.hidden_knowledge: The user is a football scout representing KRC Genk (team_api_id = 9987). This determines which players should be filtered as 'affiliated with our club'.

WITH krc_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_api_id = 9987 OR away_team_api_id = 9987
),
player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        MAX(pa.overall_rating) AS highest_rating,
        COUNT(pa.id) AS total_evaluations
    FROM Player p
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    INNER JOIN krc_players kp ON p.player_api_id = kp.player_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
    HAVING MAX(pa.overall_rating) > 80
)

    ps.player_name AS full_name,
    ps.highest_rating,
    (SELECT pa2.date FROM Player_Attributes pa2 
     WHERE pa2.player_api_id = ps.player_api_id 
     AND pa2.overall_rating = ps.highest_rating
     ORDER BY pa2.date DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS date_of_peak_rating,
    ps.total_evaluations
FROM player_stats ps
ORDER BY ps.highest_rating DESC;

    SELECT DISTINCT m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN "League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'France Ligue 1'

    WHERE l.name = 'France Ligue 1'

league_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.date,
        AVG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS pop_mean,
        AVG(POWER(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed - sub.avg_per_date, 2)) AS pop_variance
    FROM "Team_Attributes" ta
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT date, AVG(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS avg_per_date
        FROM "Team_Attributes"
        WHERE team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM france_ligue1_teams)

    GROUP BY ta.date

    SELECT 
        tpa.date,
        tpa.buildUpPlaySpeed,
        tpa.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
        (tpa.buildUpPlaySpeed - ls.pop_mean) / NULLIF(SQRT(ls.pop_variance), 0) AS z_score
    FROM "Team" t
    JOIN "Team_Attributes" tpa ON t.team_api_id = tpa.team_api_id

SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_api_id = 9987 THEN m.home_team_goal 
             WHEN m.away_team_api_id = 9987 THEN m.away_team_goal 
             ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS total_goals
FROM "Match" m
WHERE m.home_team_api_id = 9987 OR m.away_team_api_id = 9987

WITH latest_season AS (
  SELECT MAX("season") AS season
  FROM "Match"
  WHERE home_team_api_id = 9987 OR away_team_api_id = 9987
)
SELECT 
  SUM(
    CASE 
      WHEN m.home_team_api_id = 9987 THEN m.home_team_goal
      WHEN m.away_team_api_id = 9987 THEN m.away_team_goal
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS total_goals
FROM "Match" m
CROSS JOIN latest_season ls
WHERE (m.home_team_api_id = 9987 OR m.away_team_api_id = 9987)
  AND m."season" = ls.season;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_api_id = 9993 THEN home_team_goal ELSE 0 END) +
     SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_api_id = 9993 THEN away_team_goal ELSE 0 END)) AS total_goals
FROM "Match"
WHERE season = (SELECT MAX(season) FROM "Match");
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_api_id = 9993 THEN home_team_goal ELSE away_team_goal END) AS total_goals FROM Match WHERE home_team_api_id = 9993 OR away_team_api_id = 9993

WITH max_season AS (SELECT MAX(season) AS season FROM "Match") SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(home_team_goal),0) FROM "Match" WHERE home_team_api_id = 9993 AND season = (SELECT season FROM max_season)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(away_team_goal),0) FROM "Match" WHERE away_team_api_id = 9993 AND season = (SELECT season FROM max_season)) AS total_goals;

questions.nlq: Yo! I'm super interested in my team's build-up speed lately. Can you pull together a report showing whenever the squad sped up compared to their last measurement? I want you to rank the speed boosts from biggest to smallest and just hand me the top 5 updates for my specific club. Thanks a bunch!

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH SpeedChanges AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.date,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeed AS current_speed,
        LAG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.date) AS previous_speed,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeed - LAG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.date) AS speed_boost
    FROM "Team_Attributes" ta
    JOIN "Team" t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KRC Genk'
)
SELECT speed_boost
FROM SpeedChanges
WHERE speed_boost > 0
ORDER BY speed_boost DESC
LIMIT 5

    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KRC Genk'

    FROM attrs
)

       (buildUpPlaySpeed - prev_speed) AS speed_boost
FROM calc

  AND (buildUpPlaySpeed - prev_speed) > 0
ORDER BY speed_boost DESC
LIMIT 5;

    INNER JOIN "Team" t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id

WITH barcelona_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN "Team" t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE t.team_fifa_api_id = 8634
        OR m.away_team_api_id IN (
            SELECT team_api_id FROM "Team" WHERE team_fifa_api_id = 8634
        )
),
player_dribbling_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.player_api_id,
        strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS year,
        pa.dribbling,
        pa.overall_rating
    FROM "Player_Attributes" pa
    WHERE pa.player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM barcelona_players)
        AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2016'
),
player_dribbling_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.player_api_id,
        d1.year,
        d1.dribbling,
        d1.overall_rating,
        CASE 
            WHEN d2.dribbling IS NOT NULL THEN d1.dribbling - d2.dribbling
            ELSE NULL
        END AS dribbling_improvement
    FROM player_dribbling_yearly d1
    LEFT JOIN player_dribbling_yearly d2 
        ON d1.player_api_id = d2.player_api_id 
        AND d1.year = CAST(d2.year AS INTEGER) + 1
),
years_with_positive_improvement AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        COUNT(*) AS positive_improvement_count
    FROM player_dribbling_diff
    WHERE dribbling_improvement > 0
    GROUP BY player_api_id
),
continuous_improving_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM years_with_positive_improvement
    WHERE positive_improvement_count >= 5
),
highest_improvement_period AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.player_api_id,
        pd.year AS start_year,
        MAX(pd.start_year) OVER (PARTITION BY pd.player_api_id ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN pd.dribbling_improvement > 0 THEN pd.dribbling_improvement ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS highest_start_year
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            player_api_id,
            MIN(year) AS start_year,
            SUM(dribbling_improvement) AS total_improvement
        FROM player_dribbling_diff
        WHERE dribbling_improvement > 0
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) pd
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        cip.player_api_id,
        AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
    FROM continuous_improving_players cip
    JOIN "Player_Attributes" pa ON cip.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2016'
    GROUP BY cip.player_api_id
)
SELECT * FROM final_result;
